hello.text: Ah. Forgive me, I'm mid-count. Pell Duvane, assessor, under the Council's Ordinance Nine. You're not a barrel, so you're not on my list. Was there something?

count.text: Everything the Abbey keeps against winter. The Council takes a tenth of what is there. Ordinance Nine, article two. Not a tenth of what someone wishes were there. I'm very particular about that part.

fair.text: Fair? A tenth is a tenth. Whether the war in the gap is worth a tenth of the Abbey's beans is above my office. I count. I count honestly. I'm afraid that's all I can promise.

salved.text: The knee's much better, thank you. I've made a note. Not of who, since nobody will tell me. Only that someone here was kind to the Council's man. That's not on any list either.

counted.text: The Abbess's count and mine agree to the barrel. To the barrel! I'm told that's unusual. It shouldn't be. Ordinance Nine, article two.
